items.summary: A study explores hierarchical retrieval methods for long-document question answering, finding that traditional flat retrieval can miss important information by focusing too narrowly, while summary tree approaches like RAPTOR provide more comprehensive results. The research contributes to enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of information extraction from extensive texts without relying on costly language model summaries.
